free_tier.stated: New accounts get USD 3.00 of credit at sign-up. After that usage is prepaid in the wallet; glm-5.3-flash is USD 0.09 per million input tokens.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages endpoints with an sk- key
chaining: the one-off USD 3 signup credit binds before the prepaid wallet and per-token prices

limits.value: USD 3.00 signup credit, then prepaid wallet

identity_cost.detail: sign in at inferris.ai and open API keys; the signup credit is added on account creation

reliability_note: a 403 with insufficient_user_quota means the balance or key quota is used up; a 429 means rate limit or capacity; a Cloudflare edge block can appear as a plain-text 403 with an error code

evidence.proved: new accounts receive USD 3 of signup credit; later usage is prepaid in the wallet
evidence.quote: New accounts get $3.00 of credit at sign-up. After that you prepay in Wallet (https://inferris.ai/wallet).

notes: the only free allowance is a one-off USD 3 signup credit, after which usage is prepaid
